notes:
- A seasonal sky, in the shape you pick: Snow, sakura, clover, maple, fireflies and bubbles can drift over every page. Settings > Personalisation > Seasonal effects previews the sky, switches it on and changes the shape. Every shape is a drawn vector, never an emoji, and the overlay never takes a tap.
- Density, size and drift are yours to set: Sliders choose how many particles fall, how big they are and how fast they travel. The preview follows your finger and writes once when you let go, and raising the density adds flakes rather than re-rolling the ones already falling.
- The sky stops when you are not looking: It pauses off screen and holds still under Instant motion. Its clock is read in the draw phase, so the page underneath is never recomposed. Off until you switch it on.
